This blog is an outlet for ideas which naturally interest me. I keep the posts informal and back-of-the-napkin, in the spirit of [Tom Tango](http://www.tangotiger.com/index.php). They are grouped by topic in the header and appear chronologically below.
:::

## Featured research

- [Goalie Performance](/research/goalie-performance/) — Estimating talent while respecting small-sample uncertainty. · 15 min
- [NHL Pick Probability](/research/nhl-pick-probability/) — Turning rankings into pick distributions and decisions. · 22 min
- [Post-regulation](/post-regulation/) — What three-on-three overtime adds to NHL standings, and what predicts the next goal.

## Projects
